# Xingfa Tiếu Nghĩa (Công ty TNHH Cơ Khí Tiếu Nghĩa)

> Steel doors, Xingfa aluminium doors and windows, tempered glass, prefab EPS/PU sandwich panel houses, modern canopies and aluminium kitchens – fabricated and installed in Tây Ninh, Vietnam. Free on-site survey; prices are quoted after the survey ("Contact for quote"). Website in Vietnamese, English and Simplified Chinese.

- Company: Tiếu Nghĩa Mechanical Co., Ltd (Công ty TNHH Cơ Khí Tiếu Nghĩa), brand "Xingfa Tiếu Nghĩa"
- Address: 12 Ấp An Thuận, xã An Ninh, tỉnh Tây Ninh, Việt Nam
- Hotline / Zalo: 0976 224 875 (+84 976 224 875) · Email: nhomkinhtieunghia@gmail.com
- Opening hours: 08:00–17:00, Monday–Sunday · Service area: Tây Ninh and nearby areas
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/cokhixingfatieunghia/
- Languages: Vietnamese, English, Simplified Chinese (add ?lang=en or ?lang=zh to any page)

## Services
- [Steel Doors – Gates – Railings](https://nhomkinhtieunghia-sys.github.io/xingfa-tieunghia/san-pham.html?nhom=cua-sat): Many designs – sturdy, safe and attractive.
- [Xingfa Aluminium Doors](https://nhomkinhtieunghia-sys.github.io/xingfa-tieunghia/san-pham.html?nhom=cua-nhom): Imported Xingfa aluminium with superior sound and heat insulation.
- [Prefab Panel Houses](https://nhomkinhtieunghia-sys.github.io/xingfa-tieunghia/san-pham.html?nhom=nha-panel): Very fast to build, cost-saving and well insulated.
- [Aluminium Kitchens & Furniture](https://nhomkinhtieunghia-sys.github.io/xingfa-tieunghia/san-pham.html?nhom=tu-bep): Termite- and mould-proof, durable and good-looking for years.
- [Modern Canopies](https://nhomkinhtieunghia-sys.github.io/xingfa-tieunghia/san-pham.html?nhom=mai-che): Shelter from sun and rain with modern designs and durable materials.
- [Maintenance & Repair](https://nhomkinhtieunghia-sys.github.io/xingfa-tieunghia/san-pham.html?nhom=bao-tri): Fast, professional and caring repairs.

## Tiếng Việt
Xingfa Tiếu Nghĩa – Công ty TNHH Cơ Khí Tiếu Nghĩa: gia công, lắp đặt cửa sắt – cổng – lan can, cửa nhôm Xingfa, cửa kính cường lực, nhà lắp ráp panel EPS/PU, mái che, tủ bếp & nội thất nhôm, bảo trì sửa chữa tại Tây Ninh. Khảo sát đo đạc tận nơi miễn phí, báo giá sau khảo sát (giá: Liên hệ). Địa chỉ: 12 Ấp An Thuận, xã An Ninh, tỉnh Tây Ninh. Hotline/Zalo: 0976 224 875. Giờ làm việc 8:00–17:00, thứ Hai – Chủ nhật.
